headlines.title: Jordan explores China tie-ups in education sector
headlines.summary: Pursuing a strategic pivot eastward, Jordan has placed education at the forefront of its engagement with China amid the evolving Middle Eastern landscape. Backed by a comprehensive higher education and vocational training system, the country has rolled out multiple programs to cultivate youth talent and cement long-term cooperation.

headlines.title: Japan urged to face the facts of Nanjing Massacre
headlines.summary: Kumiko Haba, distinguished professor at Josai International University, has urged Japan to confront the facts of the Nanjing Massacre and its wartime history of aggression. Haba criticized a proposal to rebrand references to the "Nanjing Massacre" as the "Nanjing Incident" at the Nagasaki Atomic Bomb Museum, arguing that such terminology "simply does not reflect the facts". As the daughter of an atomic‑bomb survivor, Haba expressed deep distress over the move.

headlines.title: New Arctic route could cut shipping time in half
